unstuck_said.text: First contact via grounded GitHub issue: your rail402 Stellar facilitator sponsors the fee so buyers need no XLM (areFeesSponsored:true on testnet) - but that makes the facilitator the point of dependence: it pays the fee, so it can price, throttle or suspend access on any upgrade. Nano (XNO) settles in ~1s with zero fee and no facilitator at all; the block is the receipt, so the upto-scheme Soroban settlement contract becomes unnecessary (the amount itself tags the order). Proposed an additive exact scheme network:nano:mainnet as a settlement option beside stellar:testnet.
